days.title: Religious Heights and Summits
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Montevergine
stops.detail: The park is situated on the Partenio range, among which Montevergine stands out, the mountain where the Sanctuary of Montevergine rises, in the hamlet of Mercogliano.

stops.name: monte San Silvestro
stops.detail: One of the 30 trails present in the park leads to Mount San Silvestro, specifically number 205.

days.title: Summonte Hiking and Equestrian Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Campus di ingegneria naturalistica
stops.detail: Another point of naturalistic interest also located in Summonte in the middle of the hiking trail is the Campus of naturalistic engineering where one can observe a landscape of enormous naturalistic and environmental charm with remarkable chestnut woods.

stops.name: rifugio Urupreta
stops.detail: At the Urupreta refuge in Summonte, there is a center that represents a rest point and a picnic area for hikers who undertake mountain paths and excursions starting right from the refuge which is the beginning of the trail.

stops.name: Castellone
stops.detail: Also on the hiking trail from Summonte one can find a riding stable in the locality of Castellone near the Castellone Equestrian Center where a hiker can decide to continue the journey on horseback.

days.title: Pannarano Nature and Caves
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Oasi WWF Montagna di Sopra di Pannarano
stops.detail: The WWF Oasis Montagna di Sopra di Pannarano is located within it.

stops.name: grotte di San Silvestro
stops.detail: In the Partenio regional park there are various points of interest starting from the WWF Oasis Montagna di Sopra located near the caves of San Silvestro, in the municipality of Pannarano, within a site of community interest.

stops.name: Mafariello
stops.detail: Mafariello is a mountain locality (770 m a.s.l.) located in the park, in the municipality of San Martino Valle Caudina (AV).
